title: When the Witness Sings
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Xanthe Okonkwo, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
